questions.subject: MARKETING
questions.stem: Verdant Beverages, a startup firm promises Tarrow buyers a distinctive design and faster delivery in a way rivals do not. What does this set of promised benefits constitute?
questions.explanation: A value proposition is the set of benefits a brand promises to deliver to customers, explaining why they should choose it. Promising a distinctive design and faster delivery distinguishes Verdant Beverages, a startup firm from alternatives and is precisely a value proposition. A price list states charges, distribution describes delivery, and a mission statement is broader and internal in focus.
questions.hint: A promised bundle of benefits to customers is a value proposition.

options.text: A value proposition, the bundle of benefits a brand promises to deliver

options.misconception: overgeneralises a specific customer promise to a whole-company credo
mistakes the promised benefits for how they are delivered
confuses promised benefits with a schedule of charges
